description: This source file defines the IBMGuardrailDetector class, which integrates IBM Guardrails detection into a language model system. It includes methods for calling IBM detection APIs, processing responses, filtering detections based on thresholds, and hooks for pre- and post-processing around LLM calls, including error handling and guardrail enforcement.

classes.name: IBMGuardrailDetector
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that interacts with IBM Guardrails API to detect content violations before, during, and after LLM calls. It supports server and orchestrator modes, with methods for making API requests, filtering detections, creating error messages, and running guardrail hooks for input validation and response moderation.
